### Proposal Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing.

### Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or a specific machine learning evaluation bottleneck? Please describe.

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented (e.g. new vectoriser adapter, vector database backend integration, ANN indexing, or visual projection).

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Enterprise / Production Relevance
How does this improvement assist engineering teams deploying enterprise vector search and clustering?
